# Pro Football: EPA StatScout

> EPA StatScout is an NFL stats app for iPhone with advanced percentile rankings: EPA per play, CPOE and YAC over expected, updated through game day. No account.

## App

- [NFL Stats App for iPhone | Pro Football: EPA StatScout](https://jackwallner.com/ios/football/index.html.md): EPA StatScout is an NFL stats app for iPhone with advanced percentile rankings: EPA per play, CPOE and YAC over expected, updated through game day. No account.
